01 다음 글의 ①~⑤ 중 흐름상 어색한 것은?
I’ll ①tell you ②about Inside Out. Its ③lesson is that emotions ④aren’t good or bad. I like the lesson. I learned that all emotions are ⑤unimportant.

questions.promptEn:
[02-05] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
People called Beatrice “Perfect Girl” because she never ⓐ ______ mistakes. She was a juggling champion. She won the talent show every year. In a cooking class, (A)그녀는 미끄러운 무언가를 밟았다. She almost fell and began to feel ⓑ ______. At the talent show, she ⓒ ______ a mistake. The salt shaker was full of pepper. Her nose itched, and she didn’t catch the water balloon or the egg. ⓓ ______ crying or running off the stage, she just laughed with everyone. That night, she had a deep sleep. After that day, people just called her Beatrice.
